name: Monopoly
overview: The Scripture passages in Genesis 47 reveal how Pharaoh, through Joseph, acquired a monopoly over the land of Egypt during a time of famine. The people, desperate for food, sold their fields to Pharaoh and became his servants, while only the priests retained their lands due to a special provision. Joseph ensured that the people could continue to sow seed and sustain their households, but they were required to give a fifth of their produce to Pharaoh, illustrating a divinely permitted system of land and food monopoly that preserved life while establishing Pharaoh's ultimate ownership.
